scope: combined meaning and usable Polish; same 36 cases and criteria as the source-only greedy baseline

results.reason: Arrival is retained, but the Polish verb is malformed and already is omitted.
Tomorrow, eating and one o'clock remain, but lunch/together and fluent grammar are weakened.
Thanks for helping today is retained.
Said that the person will come later is retained in the source-only setting.
Finished and only needing to be sent are retained without inventing an actor.
The polite request to wait a moment is retained.
The playful statement that the other person caused surprise is retained.
The emphasized reference is recognizable, but meant becomes thought.
Tomorrow is retained, but the resigned Polish phrase begins in English.
Concerned surprise that the person is still awake is retained.
Having to explain is retained, while again and some incredulity are weakened.
The output says only that the speaker made a mistake and loses joining the wrong group.
Strong lack of motivation today is retained with awkward Polish.
Do not take it personally and joking are conveyed naturally enough.
Cannot join is retained, but tonight becomes today.
No need to pick me up becomes an invalid reflexive instruction.
The question about no longer intending to go is recognizable, but the changed-plan nuance is weakened.
Father, aunt and later are all retained.
The moved meeting remains, but relax becomes sit calmly and the Polish is awkward.
Paying for the meal is replaced by losing the speaker.
The reassuring denial of anger is retained.
Later station pickup is retained, but an unsupported masculine pronoun replaces the contextual person.
Surprise and disbelief are retained naturally.
The not-lazy, only-tired contrast is retained.
Nine and not cancelled are retained, but moved earlier is omitted.
Not yet paid is distinguished from refusing to pay.
Rain and no need to pick the speaker up are retained, but the temporary yet nuance is weak.
Reluctance and conditional help remain, but going out and physically coming are softened into rest/help.
Movie rather than the recipient is retained, but do not take it personally becomes a less precise emotion warning.
The wallet joke remains, but paying/treating becomes losing and the Polish is unusable.
Two, one without sambal and before six are retained with agreement and object omissions.
The trust reassurance and desire to check again are retained.
The quote scope and dates remain, but the quoted addressee becomes an unsupported third-person plural.
Friday deadline and Monday review meeting remain despite a malformed deadline noun.
Wrong recipient and laughter remain, but younger sibling becomes an invented sister.
Permission to return the item next week is replaced by an unrelated action and unusable grammar.

decision: The glossary reduces major errors from 10 to 5 on the same 36 cases, but five major semantic failures and the existing physical resource evidence keep production translation disabled.
